subject: Trial onboarding: missed office hours + rebook / API key troubleshooting

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>

Agenda (short):

- Walk through SDK/curl example and common 401/403 fixes

Join: https://app.redwood.inference/meet/xyz-calendar-invite

From: Sofia Navarro <s.navarro@brightshift.ai>

Date: 2025-10-09T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding office hours — Thu Oct 9 11:00 PT

Hi Alex —

Really sorry — we had an executive sync run long and I missed the slot. Can we rebook? Also, we tried creating the API key per the instructions but are seeing 401 responses when making a test request from our staging environment: error text is "Unauthorized: invalid_api_key". Not sure if our network is intercepting headers — our infra team (cc'd when needed) might need a heads up.

I can do Mon Oct 13 or Tue Oct 14 morning PT. Would it be possible to record the session?

Thanks,
Sofia Navarro
Head of ML Platforms | BrightShift
s.navarro@brightshift.ai

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Navarro <s.navarro@brightshift.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-10-09T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding office hours — Thu Oct 9 11:00 PT

Hi Sofia — no worries, thanks for the note. Mon Oct 13 10:00 AM PT works on our side — I'll propose that below.

Quick triage for the 401 you saw:
- Confirm you used the full API key string (no extra whitespace) and the header is "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>"
- If you created the key in the UI, confirm the key has the "trial" scope enabled under Team > API Keys
- If your staging sits behind a proxy, ensure it is not stripping Authorization headers (common with some internal gateways)

If convenient, run this curl from a local machine to rule out gateway issues:

  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
    -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>"
    -H "Content-Type: application/json"
    -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"hello"}'

If that returns 401, send me the request-id header (if present) and a sanitized response body — I've attached quick-api-debug.txt with common error strings we see and next steps to rotate a key safely.

We can definitely record the call. I've looped in Sean (solutions eng) and Marissa (Customer Success) so they can join and follow up on infra items.

Proposed rebook: Mon Oct 13, 10:00–10:30 AM PT — I'll send an invite if that works.

Best,
Alex

From: Sofia Navarro <s.navarro@brightshift.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
Cc: BrightShift IT <it@brightshift.ai>
Date: 2025-10-10T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding office hours — Thu Oct 9 11:00 PT

Alex —

Mon Oct 13 at 10:00 PT is good. I've asked our infra team to be on standby; they saw the 401 when the test was run from our staging host but a local curl worked (so likely the proxy). We'll forward any logs if Sean wants them. Recording is great.

Attendees: myself + 1 infra engineer (Diego) + our product lead (Ava). If you plan to demo the SDK, please include a small snippet for Node (we run services in Node).

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Sofia

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Navarro <s.navarro@brightshift.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-10-10T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding office hours — Thu Oct 9 11:00 PT

Great — all set. Calendar invite and recording enabled: https://app.redwood.inference/meet/xyz-calendar-invite (I've updated the event to Mon Oct 13 10:00 PT and added Diego and Ava if they accept).

Attachments: redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf, quick-api-debug.txt

Quick Node SDK snippet to include in the invite notes:

  const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
  const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
  const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-small', input: 'hello' });

If your infra blocks outgoing Authorization headers, a temporary workaround is to route the test through a machine outside your proxy (local laptop) while we confirm gateway rules — Sean can walk through the network hints during the call.

If anything changes, reply-all. Otherwise see you Mon Oct 13 at 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.inference
